thesis.what_must_be_true: The AI capex supercycle must translate WFE order strength into AMAT shipments without export-control confiscation: >30% calendar 2026 Semi Systems growth (foundry/logic GAA + DRAM/HBM) holds, EPIC Center R&D/capex converts to share gains in gate-all-around and panel-level packaging, and the working-capital surge (AR $6,372M, inventories $6,343M at Q2) unwinds into cash in 2H – gross margin stays ~50% and CFO recovers to >$2B/quarter, funding the $13.2B buyback and 15% dividend growth without balance-sheet strain. If BIS restrictions broaden or memory/logic capex pauses, the thesis breaks.

validated.preview_note: AMAT enters Q3 with its largest guide in years ($8.95B +/-$0.5B) after record Q2 ($7.91B, +11% y/y) and a raised call for >30% calendar Semi Equipment growth. Setup is AI leverage (logic GAA, DRAM/HBM, advanced packaging) vs. two overhangs: China/BIS exposure and a massive working-capital build (AR + inventories up ~$1.6B YTD, CFO collapsed to $845M, FCF $210M). What matters: (1) does the build-plan translate to shipments – can they ship ~$9B within supply constraints and convert AR/inventory to cash; (2) mix/margin – Semi Systems GM held 54.8% in Q2, sustainability at volume is key; (3) other income noise – $685M unrealized gain flattered GAAP EPS to $3.51 vs non-GAAP $2.86 last quarter, so underlying EPS quality rests on ops not marks. Reaction hinges on 2H cash conversion and Q4 outlook, not headline beat/miss.
validated.reasoning: Anchored on Q2 filed actuals (rev 7910, GM 49.9%, op 2523, net 2806, EPS 3.51 on 799M shares, CFO 845 on heavy WC build, cash 6359) and Q3 guidance (rev 8950+/-500, NT EPS 3.36+/-0.20 ex 0.01 acq, +0.01 SBC, +0.04 intra-entity). Forecast assumes AI-driven DRAM/HBM and GAA logic sustain order strength, but trims to $8.92B (slightly below midpoint) to reflect BIS Affiliates Rule overhang (~$110M hit flagged in Q4 FY25) and logistics constraints despite increased build/inventory flagged by CFO. Gross margin edges to 50.2% on volume/leverage, R&D steps to 1055 for EPIC Center (Samsung/TSMC/SK hynix/Micron engagements), op margin ~33.8%. Other income normalized to ~$68M (interest ~90M less small impairments) vs Q2's $771M which included $685M unrealized strategic-investment gain; thus GAAP net 2604 (EPS 3.28) trails NT EPS 3.36 after $68M of add-backs. Cash flow recovers as WC outflow moderates to -799 (vs -2265 in Q2), yielding CFO 2120, capex 620 for capacity/EPIC, FCF 1500, net cash +349 to 6708. Forward quarters interpolate seasonality and EPIC/packaging (NEXX) contribution, rolling balance sheet via retained earnings (dividends $0.53 = ~421M cash) and $500M buybacks/quarter against $13.2B authorization.
